// c3a: sleeper inverse. Three goroutines park on a sync.Cond (a futex-backed wait); a sleeper broadcasts after
// a delay. checkdead must stay quiet while the waits are reachable through the sleeper.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	var mu sync.Mutex
	cond := sync.NewCond(&mu)
	ready := false
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			mu.Lock()
			for !ready {
				cond.Wait()
			}
			mu.Unlock()
		}()
	}
	go func() {
		time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
		mu.Lock()
		ready = true
		cond.Broadcast()
		mu.Unlock()
	}()
	wg.Wait()
	fmt.Println("all three woke")
}
